product_launches.description: A platform for clean energy developers and manufacturers to access liquidity in debt products and transferable tax credits.

overview_description.description: Crux develops a capital markets platform that supports financing activities for clean energy and critical infrastructure projects. It provides advisory services, investment solutions, market intelligence, and technology tools that help project developers, investors, lenders, manufacturers, utilities, and tax credit buyers raise, deploy, and manage capital. The platform facilitates transactions involving transferable tax credits, debt financing, tax equity, and preferred equity while providing data and workflow tools to support transaction execution and due diligence. Crux also offers market research and analytics based on transaction data to help participants evaluate financing opportunities and market conditions. Its services are designed to improve the efficiency and transparency of capital formation across the clean energy sector.
